_schema_note: candidates.<TICKER> fields, all routine-derived cache -- candidates.yaml is the only human-maintained source of which tickers to watch; a ticker present in state.json but removed from candidates.yaml is simply skipped (not evaluated, not deleted -- preserved in case it's re-added later, same 'never delete history' convention as the take-profit routine's watchlist.yaml). swing_high: the pullback-calc reference, ratchets up each run (max of prior value -- null treated as this run's current price on first sight -- and current price), and resets DOWN to the trigger price after a successful candidate alert (so the next evaluation measures a fresh pullback from that point, not the old already-alerted peak) -- identical convention to the take-profit routine's own swing_high field for its add-on judgment. watch_stage/watch_low/watch_started_at: the IDLE->WATCHING state machine tracking an in-progress pullback (mirrors the take-profit routine's dca_watch_stage/low/started_at). last_alerted_leg_high: dedup guard -- a candidate alert only fires again once swing_high has made a new leg high since the last alert (same pattern as watchlist.yaml's last_alerted_leg_high for reentry alerts). last_alert_trading_day: cooldown reference against alert_cooldown_trading_days. alert_count: informational count of how many candidate alerts have been sent for this ticker, never gates anything by itself. There is no avg_cost/exit_price concept here at all -- these tickers have never been held, so there is nothing to protect and no percentage profit/stop tiers, Trailing Stop, or Action Lock; this state exists purely to support the mechanical trend/pullback/confirmation gate, one-way (never suggests selling, only ever surfaces a candidate entry point). swing_high(v2起语义变更): 这行棘轮更新原本写在i步内部(pullback_pct计算的 前一句),但i步本身在d-h任一门槛没通过时会被短路跳过(命中就停,后面不再检查), 导致长期被d步WAIT_TREND等更早门槛拦住的candidate,即使期间价格持续创新高, swing_high也完全不会更新——GLW就是实例:2026-09-01加入观察名单时价格144.08, 到2026-09-10期间价格最高摸到169.565(+17.7%),但swing_high十天七次运行 全部停留在144.08,一次没动过。修复后这行棘轮更新移到c步(首次init)之后、 d步(趋势过滤器)之前独立执行,对每个正常评估的candidate无条件刷新为 max(原值,现价),不再依赖后面能不能通过趋势/回调/确认这些门槛;d-k步内部 只读取它做回调百分比计算,不再重复维护这行更新。2026-09-11按run_log历史 current_price字段做过一次性回填修正(144.08->169.565),不影响后续实时。
